# hibira_livechat_saved_reply (Resource)

A saved reply in a [Hibira Live Chat](https://chat.hibira.io) workspace: text agents insert by typing `/` and its shortcut in the reply box. Saved replies are on the Team and Business plans. Import with `<workspace_id>/<saved reply id>`. Uses the provider's API token, which needs write access (and delete access to remove things) and an owner or admin of the workspace as its owner; the workspace's plan must include the API (Team and up). Needs a Hibira server with API tokens on Live Chat (pusher-server#898).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hibira_livechat_saved_reply" "refund" {
  workspace_id = "ws_0123456789abcdef"
  title        = "Refund policy"
  shortcut     = "refund"
  text         = "You can ask for a refund within 30 days of your order from your account's Orders page."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `text` (String) The reply's text, at most 2,000 characters.
- `title` (String) Shown in the list of saved replies.
- `workspace_id` (String) The Live Chat workspace's ID (`ws_...`, in Live Chat's Settings, or `GET /v1/workspaces`). Changing it makes a new one there.

### Optional

- `shortcut` (String) What follows `/` in the reply box, unique in the workspace: up to 32 letters, digits, `-` and `_`. Empty (default): none.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The saved reply's ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import hibira_livechat_saved_reply.refund ws_0123456789abcdef/sr_0123456789
```
